fivebar_fk — DRIVE puck op

• Data kinds: signal × table → any

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.fivebar_fk(q, link: 'dict', *, branch: 'str' = 'forward') (to call the implementation directly, import puck; puck.fivebar_fk(q, link: 'dict', *, branch: 'str' = 'forward'); from the registry, opsdrive.get("fivebar_fk"))

Usage

Forward kinematics: joint angles (q₁, q₂) (angle of each arm's proximal link from the x axis) → tip E. Elbow Bᵢ = Aᵢ + l₁(cos qᵢ, sin qᵢ), E = the "forward" (larger-x side) or "back" point of circle(B₁, l₂) ∩ circle(B₂, l₂). Return value {"E", "B1", "B2"}, or None if they do not intersect.
